response.overview: After her father’s death, Emma sets out alone on the Hälsingeleden trail to honour his memory and find her way back to herself. But what begins in tranquillity soon turns into a nightmare. Someone is following her every step. Cut off from the outside world, with fewer and fewer ways to escape, she is forced to keep moving. As the forest closes in, the hike becomes a fight against her pursuer, her grief and her own fear. How far can a person be pushed before she fights back?
response.tagline: A solitary hike. An unknown pursuer. No way back.
response.title: Villebråd
